name: Rajalakshmi Engineering College
summary: Rajalakshmi Engineering College was established in 1997 at Rajalakshmi Nagar, Thandalam, and is an autonomous college affiliated to Anna University. NAAC re-accredited it A++ (third cycle) from April 2023 to April 2028. It offers 14 UG and 9 PG programmes; Edugate lists the 10 UG programmes it has verified. The college reports placing 1,549 students in 2023–24.
